description:
Search 116,086 UN/LOCODE transport locations worldwide — ports, airports, rail and road terminals, inland container depots and border crossings. Codes are 5 characters: a 2-letter ISO country code + a 3-character location code (GBLHR = London Heathrow, NLRTM = Rotterdam).

Provide code for an exact record, or query (name search, min 2 chars) optionally narrowed by country and function_type; limit caps results (default 20, max 100). The spaced notation "GB LHR" reads as GBLHR in either.

Behavior: read-only; exact code hits are provenance-based while fuzzy name hits report match quality via the envelope's confidence (basis match_quality); an unknown code errors with a not-found message. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets.

Returns: the location record(s) — code, name and name_ascii, country, subdivision, functions[], status, coordinates {lat, lon} and iata_code where assigned — under result, plus confidence, _source and citation (the FreightUtils v1 response envelope).

Limitations: an administrative code list (UNECE UN/LOCODE 2025-1) — confirm operational status and coordinates with the port or authority before critical use.

Related: airport_lookup (airport-specific records including ICAO codes), nearest_airport (find airports by coordinates).

Identifiers: Each record carries fu_id, a stable FreightUtils identifier (and fu_version_id where the dataset has editions); resolve_reference resolves one to exactly its record.

code.description: Exact UN/LOCODE — 5 characters, optionally spaced. Examples: "GBLHR", "GB LHR", "NLRTM".

codes.description: Batch: up to 50 UN/LOCODEs. Send alone; answered as results[] in input order, each with its own status. One call against the daily limit, N against the Pro monthly allowance.

country.description: Filter by 2-letter ISO country code. Examples: "GB", "NL".

name: unlocode_lookup

kind.description: watched (its upstream is fetched daily) or checksum-only (no upstream of its own).

last_success.description: The last day (YYYY-MM-DD) the upstream check succeeded; null when none is recorded.

stale.description: True only when a dataset below missed its upstream check window (window_missed).

state.description: The worst state of the datasets below.

state_read_at.description: When the site upstream check recorded the state (ISO 8601); null when it could not be read.

anyOf.description: Stable FreightUtils identifier of this record, fu:<namespace>:<key> — the same across editions; resolve_reference resolves it to exactly this record.
This record in one dataset edition, fu_id@<edition>. Present only where the dataset has editions (absent on airlines, ULDs, containers, vehicles).
